description: The pie chart visually represents the time distribution between two key components of the Paper Copilot system: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger orange segment labeled “Reduction” accounting for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total time), and the smaller blue segment labeled “Efficient deployment” representing 26.2 seconds (30.08%). The “Reduction” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded outward from the center, drawing attention to its dominant share. No legend is present, as the labels are directly placed next to their respective slices, and percentage values are shown both numerically and as a proportion of the total. The chart suggests that the majority of processing time in this system is consumed by the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but still significant portion.
